entries.meaningZh: 印第安人〔贬义、冒犯性旧称〕
entries.en: The editor objected when a character called his neighbour a Red Indian.
entries.zh: 一个角色用冒犯性旧称称呼邻居为印第安人时，编辑提出了异议。

entries.meaningZh: 休战纪念日〔英国纪念日〕
entries.en: She found the handwritten programme for a British Remembrance Day ceremony inside the old diary.
entries.zh: 她在旧日记里找到了一份手写的英国休战纪念日仪式程序单。

entries.en: His friends called him a Renaissance man because he painted, composed music and studied astronomy.
entries.zh: 朋友们称他为多才多艺的人，因为他画画、作曲，还研究天文学。

entries.en: The class compared earthquake magnitudes reported on the Richter scale.
entries.zh: 全班比较了以里氏震级标度报告的地震震级。

entries.en: A Roman Catholic in the novel shares a workshop with two old friends.
entries.zh: 小说里的一位罗马天主教徒与两位老朋友共用一间工坊。

entries.en: Her essay compares two historical accounts of Roman Catholicism without endorsing either author's conclusions.
entries.zh: 她的文章比较了两种对罗马天主教的历史叙述，但没有赞同任何一位作者的结论。

entries.meaningZh: 罗马字母表；拉丁字母表
entries.en: She arranged wooden letters of the Roman alphabet along the classroom windowsill.
entries.zh: 她把罗马字母表的木制字母排列在教室窗台上。

entries.en: The clockmaker replaced a missing Roman numeral on the old clock face.
entries.zh: 钟表匠为那只旧钟的钟面补上了一个缺失的罗马数字。

entries.meaningZh: 俄式轮盘赌〔危险的赌命游戏〕
entries.en: The drama condemns the friends who pressure a newcomer into playing Russian roulette.
entries.zh: 这部戏谴责了那些逼迫新来者玩俄式轮盘赌的朋友。

entries.meaningZh: 单一连接站〔FDDI计算机网络〕
entries.en: The diagram showed a single-attachment station (SAS) beside the concentrator.
entries.zh: 示意图在集中器旁画出了一台单一连接站。

entries.en: The film shows a SWAT team arriving after the residents have left the building.
entries.zh: 电影里，居民们离开大楼后，一支特警队才到达。

entries.en: The historian found an old Salvation Army fundraising appeal among the donated papers.
entries.zh: 历史学家在捐赠文件中找到了一份救世军的旧募捐呼吁书。

entries.meaningZh: 圣诞老人〔传统虚构角色〕
entries.en: The child drew Santa Claus beside a house with a crooked chimney.
entries.zh: 孩子把圣诞老人画在一座烟囱歪斜的房子旁边。

entries.en: We shared a Scotch egg while waiting for the delayed train.
entries.zh: 等候晚点的火车时，我们分着吃了一个苏格兰香肠蛋。

entries.en: A Scotswoman in our class lent me her notes from the previous seminar.
entries.zh: 我们班的一位苏格兰女人把上次研讨课的笔记借给了我。

entries.en: She compared two family diaries written during the Second World War.
entries.zh: 她比较了两本写于第二次世界大战期间的家庭日记。

entries.en: The historian compared two archived speeches delivered at the United Nations Security Council.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了两篇在联合国安全理事会发表的存档演说。

entries.en: They found a photograph of their Shrove Tuesday gathering inside the family recipe book.
entries.zh: 他们在家传食谱里找到了一张忏悔星期二聚会的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 连体双胞胎中的一人〔旧称，现被视为冒犯性称呼〕
entries.en: The old memoir describes the childhood of the Siamese twins in their own words.
entries.zh: 那部旧回忆录用那对连体双胞胎自己的话讲述了他们的童年。

entries.meaningZh: 倒霉定律〔英式非正式、戏谑说法〕
entries.en: We joked about Sod's Law when rain began just after we packed away the umbrella.
entries.zh: 我们刚把伞收起来就下雨了，于是拿“倒霉定律”开玩笑。

entries.en: She marked the South Pole on the globe before discussing the expedition diaries.
entries.zh: 她先在地球仪上标出南极点，然后讨论那些探险日记。

entries.meaningZh: 政治保安处〔英国历史警察部门名称〕
entries.en: The novel follows a retired British Special Branch officer as he sorts his old papers.
entries.zh: 小说写一位退休的英国政治保安处警官整理自己的旧文件。

entries.en: The archivist compared two old U.S. State Department letters before cataloguing them.
entries.zh: 档案管理员先比较了两封美国国务院的旧信，然后将它们编入目录。

entries.en: The curator placed the Stone Age tools beside a drawing of the excavation.
entries.zh: 策展人把石器时代工具摆在一幅发掘现场图旁。

entries.en: She helped stack the chairs after Sunday school before walking home.
entries.zh: 主日学校的课程结束后，她帮忙把椅子叠好，然后步行回家。

entries.en: He cut the Swiss cheese into small pieces for the picnic.
entries.zh: 他把瑞士硬干酪切成小块，准备野餐时吃。

entries.en: The waiter brought the T-bone steak after clearing the empty soup bowls.
entries.zh: 服务员收走空汤碗后，端来了T骨牛排。

entries.en: We waited at the T-junction until our friend caught up on her bicycle.
entries.zh: 我们在T字形路口等着，直到朋友骑自行车赶上来。

entries.en: He bought a TV dinner but changed his mind and joined us for supper.
entries.zh: 他买了一份冷冻快餐，后来改了主意，和我们一起吃晚饭。

entries.en: The student borrowed an introductory book on Taoism before visiting the exhibition.
entries.zh: 那位学生在参观展览前借了一本道教入门书。

entries.meaningZh: 太保〔英国旧式青年称呼〕
entries.en: The costume designer studied photographs of a Teddy boy before sketching the jacket.
entries.zh: 服装设计师研究了一位英国太保青年的照片，然后画出夹克的草图。

entries.meaningZh: 英国地方自卫队〔历史组织名〕
entries.en: The historian found a British Territorial Army photograph inside the veteran's old notebook.
entries.zh: 历史学家在那位退伍军人的旧笔记本里找到了一张英国地方自卫队的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 第三世界〔旧称；有时被视为冒犯〕
entries.en: The essay compares portrayals of the Third World in two old newspaper articles.
entries.zh: 这篇文章比较了两篇旧报纸文章对第三世界的描绘。

entries.meaningZh: 妥瑞氏症；妥瑞氏症候群
entries.en: The documentary includes an interview with a musician who has Tourette's syndrome.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片收录了对一位患有妥瑞氏症的音乐人的采访。

entries.meaningZh: 特洛伊木马；内部颠覆者
entries.en: The committee feared that the proposed partnership might become a Trojan horse.
entries.zh: 委员会担心，提议中的合作关系可能变成从内部进行颠覆的特洛伊木马。

entries.en: She traced the Tropic of Cancer across the map with her finger.
entries.zh: 她用手指沿着地图上的北回归线划过。

entries.en: The student marked the Tropic of Capricorn in blue on the worksheet map.
entries.zh: 那位学生在练习纸的地图上用蓝色标出了南回归线。

entries.en: The travel diary describes a conversation in the waiting room of a Turkish bath.
entries.zh: 旅行日记描写了在一处土耳其浴场等候室里的交谈。

entries.en: The technician compared two archived recordings of UHF radio signals.
entries.zh: 技术员比较了两份存档的超高频无线电信号记录。

entries.meaningZh: 山姆大叔〔美国的拟人化角色〕
entries.en: The illustrator drew Uncle Sam holding an oversized envelope in the cartoon.
entries.zh: 插画师在漫画里画了手持一个超大信封的山姆大叔。

entries.meaningZh: 汤姆叔叔〔斯托小说中的人物〕
entries.en: The seminar compared two stage adaptations of Stowe's character Uncle Tom.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了对斯托夫人笔下人物汤姆叔叔的两种舞台改编。

entries.en: The stagehand folded the Union Jack after the final scene of the play.
entries.zh: 戏剧最后一场结束后，舞台工作人员把英国国旗叠了起来。

entries.en: Their travel notebook contained sketches made during a visit to the United Kingdom.
entries.zh: 他们的旅行笔记本里有一些绘于到访联合王国期间的速写。

entries.en: The historian compared two old United Nations reports before writing the exhibition notes.
entries.zh: 历史学家先比较了两份联合国旧报告，然后撰写展览说明。

entries.meaningZh: 退伍军人节〔美国纪念日〕
entries.en: She found an American Veterans Day programme tucked between two pages of the diary.
entries.zh: 她在日记的两页之间找到了一份美国退伍军人节活动程序单。

entries.meaningZh: 向操作员发送信息〔计算机中的 WTO 命令〕
entries.en: The programmer checked the WTO command in the archived console script.
entries.zh: 程序员核查了存档控制台脚本中向操作员发送信息的WTO命令。

entries.meaningZh: 全球信息网〔World Wide Web 的缩写〕
entries.en: The archivist compared two early sites preserved from the World Wide Web (WWW).
entries.zh: 档案管理员比较了从全球信息网（WWW）保存下来的两个早期网站。

entries.en: We walked along Wall Street before meeting our friends at a nearby cafe.
entries.zh: 我们沿着华尔街散步，然后到附近一家咖啡馆与朋友见面。

entries.en: A West Indian in the story opens a small bookshop beside the railway station.
entries.zh: 故事里的一位西印度群岛居民在火车站旁开了一家小书店。

entries.en: The radio interview explored how Wicca had influenced the guest's poetry.
entries.zh: 那次广播访谈探讨了Wicca这一宗教如何影响了嘉宾的诗歌。

entries.meaningZh: 美国西部〔边疆时期的历史称呼〕
entries.en: The designer studied two posters for films set in the Wild West.
entries.zh: 设计师研究了两张以美国历史上的西部边疆地区为背景的电影海报。

entries.en: The researcher compared two archived World Trade Organization speeches for her dissertation.
entries.zh: 那位研究者为学位论文比较了两篇世界贸易组织的存档演说。

entries.en: The student marked the X chromosome on a copy of the teaching diagram.
entries.zh: 那位学生在教学图的副本上标出了X染色体。

entries.en: We planned to spend Xmas in the little house beside the lake.
entries.zh: 我们计划在湖边那座小房子里过圣诞节。

entries.en: The researcher checked the Y chromosome image against the original laboratory notebook.
entries.zh: 这位研究者对照原始实验笔记核查了Y染色体图像。

entries.en: The memoir describes the family's preparations for Yom Kippur in their new home.
entries.zh: 这部回忆录描写了那家人在新家里为犹太教赎罪日做的准备。

entries.en: We saved a piece of Yorkshire pudding for the guest arriving later.
entries.zh: 我们给稍后到达的客人留了一块约克郡布丁。

entries.en: He moved the spare chair so that she could reach her Zimmer frame.
entries.zh: 他挪开了那把多余的椅子，好让她够到齐默式助行架。

entries.en: She heard the complete recording for the first time on the train home.
entries.zh: 回家的火车上，她第一次听到了完整的录音。

entries.en: We decided to go Dutch because nobody wanted to pay for the whole meal.
entries.zh: 我们决定平摊费用，因为没有人想付整顿饭的钱。

entries.meaningZh: 教堂；供会众祈祷的宗教建筑
entries.en: The memoir describes a house of God that also sheltered travellers during storms.
entries.zh: 这部回忆录描写了一座也在暴风雨中收留旅人的宗教建筑。

entries.en: The director returned to off-Broadway after several years in television.
entries.zh: 这位导演在电视界工作数年后，回到了外百老汇戏剧界。

entries.meaningZh: 丝毫不差地；恰到好处地
entries.en: The description in your letter fitted our new neighbour to a T.
entries.zh: 你信中的描述与我们的新邻居完全吻合。

entries.meaningZh: 欧洲共同市场〔历史组织称呼〕
entries.en: The historian compared two old letters discussing Britain's application to join the Common Market.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了两封讨论英国申请加入欧洲共同市场的旧信。

entries.en: Her friend in New York City mailed back the borrowed drawings in a sturdy cardboard tube.
entries.zh: 她在纽约市的朋友把借用的画放在一只结实的硬纸筒里寄还。

entries.en: She studied for an O level in history while helping in the family shop.
entries.zh: 她一边帮家里的商店做事，一边准备历史科普通程度考试。

entries.en: The old catalogue placed Scots pottery beside examples from several other regions.
entries.zh: 那份旧目录把苏格兰陶器与其他几个地区的陶器样品列在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 艾伦螺丝〔头部有内六角孔〕
entries.en: The repairer found a loose Allen screw beneath the bicycle stand.
entries.zh: 维修人员在自行车支架下发现了一颗松脱的艾伦螺丝。

entries.en: She borrowed an Allen wrench before assembling the new bookshelf.
entries.zh: 她在组装新书架之前借了一把内六角扳手。

entries.en: The students compared two drawings of an AND circuit before checking their answers.
entries.zh: 学生们先比较了两张与电路的示意图，然后核对答案。

entries.en: We checked the AND gate's truth table against the teacher's notes.
entries.zh: 我们对照老师的笔记核查了与门的真值表。

entries.en: The researcher compared two published measurements of angiotensin II in the archived data.
entries.zh: 这位研究者比较了存档数据中两份已发表的血管紧张素II测量结果。

entries.en: The radio historian found an old diagram of the Appleton layer in the textbook.
entries.zh: 这位无线电史研究者在教科书里找到了一幅阿普尔顿层的旧示意图。

entries.en: The chemistry tutor compared two historical explanations of the Arrhenius theory of dissociation.
entries.zh: 化学导师比较了对阿伦尼乌斯电离学说的两种历史解释。

entries.en: The programmer checked whether every symbol belonged to the ASCII character set.
entries.zh: 程序员检查了每个符号是否都属于ASCII字符集。

entries.en: She saved the short list as an ASCII text file before sending it.
entries.zh: 她把那份简短清单存成ASCII文本文件后才发送。

entries.en: We found an audio CD of the concert inside the old programme.
entries.zh: 我们在那本旧节目册里发现了一张那场音乐会的音频光盘。

entries.en: The students compared two historical accounts of the Battle of Hastings.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了对海斯汀斯战役的两种历史叙述。

entries.en: The museum displayed a damaged painting of the Battle of Trafalgar beside the diary.
entries.zh: 博物馆在那本日记旁陈列了一幅描绘特拉法尔加之战的受损画作。

entries.en: He ordered beef Stroganoff and asked for a jug of water.
entries.zh: 他点了俄式奶油牛柳丝，又要了一壶水。

entries.en: The restaurant had sold its last portion of beef Wellington before we arrived.
entries.zh: 我们到达之前，餐厅已经卖掉了最后一份威灵顿牛柳。

entries.meaningZh: 彭戴处理方法〔印刷图像处理〕
entries.en: The printmaker compared two portraits produced using the Benday process.
entries.zh: 版画师比较了两幅采用彭戴处理方法制作的肖像。

entries.meaningZh: 伯努利定律〔概率统计语境〕
entries.en: The statistics tutor asked us to compare two explanations of Bernoulli's law.
entries.zh: 统计学导师让我们比较对伯努利定律的两种解释。

entries.en: The historian examined newspaper reports about the illegal trade in big H.
entries.zh: 这位历史学家研究了有关海洛因非法交易的报纸报道。

entries.meaningZh: 球出手后下意识配合的身体动作
entries.en: The bowler's body English amused his friends after the ball had left his hand.
entries.zh: 球离手后，那位保龄球手的配合性身体动作逗乐了朋友们。

entries.en: The class compared two diagrams used to explain the Bohr theory of atomic structure.
entries.zh: 全班比较了两幅用于解释原子结构玻尔理论的图。

entries.en: The physicist checked the assumptions behind the calculation using the Boltzmann distribution law.
entries.zh: 那位物理学家检查了运用玻耳兹曼分布定律进行计算时所依据的假设。

entries.en: She used Boolean algebra to simplify the expression before drawing the circuit.
entries.zh: 她先用布尔代数简化表达式，然后画出电路。

entries.en: The tutor used a simple search exercise to introduce Boolean logic.
entries.zh: 导师用一个简单的搜索练习来介绍布尔逻辑。

entries.meaningZh: 幼子继承制〔英国历史习俗〕
entries.en: The historian compared two disputed inheritances recorded under borough English.
entries.zh: 这位历史学家比较了记载中两起按幼子继承制处理的继承纠纷。

entries.en: The student checked the assumptions before applying Bose-Einstein statistics to the model.
entries.zh: 那位学生在把玻色—爱因斯坦统计法用于模型之前，检查了所需假设。

entries.en: We shared a brown Betty after the restaurant had cleared our plates.
entries.zh: 餐厅收走我们的餐盘后，我们分着吃了一份褐色贝蒂布丁。

entries.en: The lecturer pointed to the bundle of His on the heart diagram.
entries.zh: 讲师在心脏示意图上指出了希斯氏束。

entries.en: The caller ID showed an unfamiliar number, so she let the telephone ring.
entries.zh: 来电显示上是个陌生号码，于是她没有接，任电话响着。

entries.en: The traveller marked Cape Canaveral on the map before packing her notebook.
entries.zh: 那位旅人在地图上标出卡纳维拉尔角后，才把笔记本打包。

entries.en: We compared two textbook diagrams of the Carnot cycle during the tutorial.
entries.zh: 辅导课上，我们比较了两幅教科书中的卡诺循环图。

entries.en: She drew the three points in a Cartesian coordinate system before joining them.
entries.zh: 她先在笛卡儿坐标系中画出三个点，然后把它们连起来。

entries.en: We listed the ordered pairs in the Cartesian product of the two sets.
entries.zh: 我们列出了那两个集合的笛卡儿积中的有序对。

entries.en: She ordered chicken Kiev but saved room for a small dessert.
entries.zh: 她点了基辅鸡，但留了点肚子吃一小份甜点。

entries.en: The waiter brought chicken Tetrazzini to the wrong table and quickly apologised.
entries.zh: 服务员把泰特拉齐妮鸡送错了桌，赶紧道歉。

entries.en: The translator read the passage aloud in Classical Latin before discussing the English version.
entries.zh: 译者先用古典拉丁语朗读那段文字，再讨论英文版本。

entries.en: Nobody wanted the clever Dick to interrupt another speaker with an unnecessary correction.
entries.zh: 谁都不希望那个自以为什么都懂的人用不必要的纠正打断另一位发言者。

entries.en: Their first color TV stood on a small table beside the bookcase.
entries.zh: 他们的第一台彩色电视机放在书柜旁的一张小桌上。

entries.en: The lecturer used an animation to introduce the Coriolis effect before discussing the equations.
entries.zh: 讲师先用动画介绍科里奥利效应，再讨论相关方程。

entries.en: The student checked the sign of the Coriolis force in her rotating-frame calculation.
entries.zh: 那位学生检查了旋转参照系计算中科里奥利力的正负号。

entries.en: The dressmaker compared two swatches of Courtelle before ordering the fabric.
entries.zh: 裁缝在订购织物之前，比较了两块考特尔腈纶布样。

entries.en: The dressmaker kept the crepe de Chine separate from the heavier fabrics.
entries.zh: 裁缝把双绉与较厚重的织物分开放着。

entries.en: We ordered a crepe Suzette to share after the main course.
entries.zh: 主菜之后，我们点了一份橘子黄油薄卷饼分着吃。

entries.meaningZh: 髑髅地十字架〔下设三级台阶的十字架〕
entries.en: The sculptor drew a cross of Calvary in the margin of her notebook.
entries.zh: 雕塑家在笔记本页边画了一个下设三级台阶的髑髅地十字架。

entries.en: The illustrator copied a cross of Lorraine from the old heraldic diagram.
entries.zh: 插画师照着旧纹章图临摹了一个洛林十字架。

entries.en: The researcher checked the cytotoxic T cell counts against the original worksheet.
entries.zh: 这位研究者对照原始工作表核查了细胞毒性T细胞计数。

entries.en: The students compared two biographies of Leonardo da Vinci during the seminar.
entries.zh: 研讨课上，学生们比较了两本关于意大利画家莱昂纳多·达·芬奇的传记。

entries.en: The reading rose by one degree Fahrenheit during the observation.
entries.zh: 观测期间，读数上升了一华氏度。

entries.en: The librarian used Dewey decimal classification while reorganising the donated books.
entries.zh: 图书管理员在整理捐赠图书时采用了杜威十进制分类法。

entries.en: She consulted a guide to the Dewey decimal system before assigning numbers to the new books.
entries.zh: 她在给新书分配分类号之前，查阅了杜威十进制系统指南。

entries.meaningZh: 双列直插式组件开关；DIP开关
entries.en: The technician photographed each DIP switch before documenting the old board.
entries.zh: 技术员先拍下各个DIP开关，然后为旧电路板编制档案。

entries.en: The researcher compared two archived Doppler radar images from the same storm.
entries.zh: 这位研究者比较了同一场风暴的两幅存档多普勒雷达图像。

entries.meaningZh: 莫名其妙的话；难懂的语言
entries.en: The instructions were double Dutch to me until she drew a simple diagram.
entries.zh: 那些说明对我来说完全莫名其妙，直到她画出一张简单的图。

entries.en: She ordered eggs Benedict and waited by the window with her newspaper.
entries.zh: 她点了班尼迪克蛋，拿着报纸在窗边等候。

entries.meaningZh: 厄兰〔电话通信业务量单位〕
entries.en: The engineer checked the traffic figures in erlangs before revising the capacity estimate.
entries.zh: 工程师在修改容量估计之前，核查了以厄兰为单位的业务量数据。

entries.meaningZh: 欧几里德几何；欧氏几何
entries.en: The teacher used a chalk drawing to explain a problem in Euclidean geometry.
entries.zh: 老师用粉笔画图，解释了一道欧几里德几何题。

entries.en: We compared the distances between the same points in a Euclidean space.
entries.zh: 我们比较了欧几里得空间中同一些点之间的距离。

entries.en: She found a dried flower between two pages of the family Bible.
entries.zh: 她在那本家庭用大型圣经的两页之间发现了一朵干花。

entries.en: The tutor asked why Fermi-Dirac statistics was appropriate for the proposed model.
entries.zh: 导师问，为什么费米—狄拉克统计适合所提出的模型。

entries.en: The programme checked whether the student's answer was a Fibonacci number.
entries.zh: 程序检查了学生的答案是否是一个斐波纳契数。

entries.en: She wrote the next few terms of the Fibonacci sequence on the board.
entries.zh: 她在黑板上写出了斐波纳契数列接下来的几项。

entries.en: The historian compared two soldiers' diaries describing the First Battle of Ypres.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了两本描写第一次伊普尔战役的士兵日记。

entries.en: The engineer used Fourier analysis to compare the two recorded signals.
entries.zh: 工程师运用付里叶分析比较了两份记录下来的信号。

entries.en: We compared the Fourier series approximation with the original periodic curve.
entries.zh: 我们把傅里叶级数近似与原来的周期曲线作了比较。

entries.en: The museum displayed a damaged Fresnel lens beside a photograph of the lighthouse.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一张灯塔照片旁陈列了一片受损的菲涅耳透镜。

entries.en: She drew a Gaussian curve over the histogram for comparison.
entries.zh: 她在直方图上叠画了一条高斯曲线，以便比较。

entries.meaningZh: 给·吕萨克氏定律〔气体定律名称〕
entries.en: The tutor compared explanations of Gay-Lussac's law from two historical textbooks.
entries.zh: 导师比较了两本历史教科书对给·吕萨克氏定律的解释。

entries.en: The researcher compared the frequencies in GHz before plotting the measurements.
entries.zh: 这位研究者在绘制测量结果之前，比较了以千兆赫为单位的频率。

entries.en: The publisher relied on his girl Friday to organise a box of old correspondence.
entries.zh: 出版商依靠那位忠诚能干的女助手整理一箱旧信件。

entries.meaningZh: 乐善好施者；主动助人者
entries.en: A good Samaritan returned the wallet with all the money still inside.
entries.zh: 一位好心人归还了钱包，里面的钱分文未少。

entries.en: The students arranged cards showing the Greek alphabet across the table.
entries.zh: 学生们把展示希腊字母表的卡片铺放在桌上。

entries.en: The historian compared early diagrams of the Haber-Bosch process for the exhibition.
entries.zh: 这位历史学家为展览比较了哈伯—波希制氨法的早期图示。

entries.en: The lecturer compared two old diagrams of the Heaviside layer.
entries.zh: 讲师比较了两幅关于Heaviside层的旧图示。

entries.en: The student found the helper T cell diagram in the wrong chapter of her notes.
entries.zh: 那位学生发现，辅助T细胞图被放进了笔记中错误的章节。

entries.en: The medical historian compared two old reports concerning hemophilia A.
entries.zh: 这位医学史研究者比较了两份关于甲型血友病的旧报告。

entries.en: The nurse checked the leaflet on hepatitis A before giving it to the visitor.
entries.zh: 护士核查了那份关于甲型肝炎的宣传单后，才把它交给来访者。

entries.en: The researcher compared two published surveys concerning hepatitis B.
entries.zh: 这位研究者比较了两项关于乙型肝炎的已发表调查。

entries.en: The documentary includes an interview with a doctor researching hepatitis C.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片收录了对一位研究丙型肝炎的医生的采访。

entries.en: The historian found a diagram of Hertzian waves in an old radio manual.
entries.zh: 这位历史学家在一本旧无线电手册里找到了一幅赫兹氏电波图。

entries.meaningZh: 何勒内斯卡片〔穿孔数据卡〕
entries.en: The archivist found a damaged Hollerith card inside the old computing manual.
entries.zh: 档案管理员在一本旧计算机手册里发现了一张受损的何勒内斯穿孔卡片。

entries.en: We checked the elastic-range assumption before applying Hooke's law to the measurements.
entries.zh: 我们先核查了弹性范围假设，然后用胡克氏定律分析测量结果。

entries.en: The surveyor photographed the damaged I-beam before writing the inspection report.
entries.zh: 勘察人员先拍下受损的I字梁，然后撰写检查报告。

entries.en: The actor practised international Morse code for a scene in the radio room.
entries.zh: 那位演员为无线电室的一场戏练习了国际莫尔斯电码。

entries.en: The laboratory team compared the killer T cell counts with the previous records.
entries.zh: 实验室团队把杀伤T细胞计数与以往记录作了比较。

entries.en: The museum displayed Kipp's apparatus without demonstrating its operation.
entries.zh: 博物馆陈列了基普发生器，但没有演示它的操作。

entries.en: The lecturer used a drawing of a Klein bottle to introduce the topology discussion.
entries.zh: 讲师用一幅克莱因瓶的图画引出拓扑学讨论。

entries.en: She checked the Kronecker delta indices before simplifying the sum.
entries.zh: 她先核对克罗内克符号的指标，再简化求和式。

entries.en: The class compared explanations of the law of Archimedes from two textbooks.
entries.zh: 全班比较了两本教科书对阿基米德定律的解释。

entries.en: He turned the lazy Susan so that everyone could reach the bread.
entries.zh: 他转动餐桌上的圆转盘，让每个人都能拿到面包。

entries.en: The chemistry tutor compared two diagrams illustrating the Le Chatelier-Braun principle.
entries.zh: 化学导师比较了两幅解释勒沙特—利布劳恩原理的示意图。

entries.en: The technician noticed a crack in the Liebig condenser before the demonstration began.
entries.zh: 演示开始前，技术员发现李比希冷凝器上有一道裂纹。

entries.en: The old LISP compiler rejected the programme before producing any output.
entries.zh: 那个旧LISP编译程序在产生任何输出之前就拒绝了该程序。

entries.en: His trusted man Friday organised the papers while he prepared the speech.
entries.zh: 他准备演说时，他信赖的那位得力助手整理了文件。

entries.meaningZh: 马尔可夫过程的；无后效过程的
entries.en: The researcher checked whether the proposed transition model was Markovian.
entries.zh: 这位研究者检查了所提出的转移模型是否具有马尔可夫性。

entries.en: The engineer compared the file sizes in Mbit before selecting an example.
entries.zh: 工程师先比较了以兆位为单位的文件大小，然后选择一个示例。

entries.en: The historian compared early textbook accounts of Mendeleev's law.
entries.zh: 这位历史学家比较了早期教科书对门得列夫元素周期律的叙述。

entries.en: The cartographer compared two maps drawn using the Mercator projection.
entries.zh: 制图师比较了两张采用墨卡托投影绘制的地图。

entries.en: The researcher checked the pressure measurements in mm Hg against the original chart.
entries.zh: 这位研究者对照原始图表核查了以毫米汞柱为单位的压力测量结果。

entries.en: The technician compared the NAND circuit diagram with the archived board photograph.
entries.zh: 技术员把与非电路图与存档电路板照片作了比较。

entries.en: We checked the NAND gate's truth table before continuing the exercise.
entries.zh: 我们核查了与非门的真值表后，才继续做练习。

entries.en: The student checked the Napierian logarithm calculation with her tutor.
entries.zh: 那位学生和导师一起核查了自然对数的计算。

entries.en: The archivist found an old U.S. National Science Foundation report among the donated books.
entries.zh: 档案管理员在捐赠图书中找到了一份美国国家科学基金会的旧报告。

entries.en: The engineer checked the assumed Nyquist rate before comparing the sampled recordings.
entries.zh: 工程师先核查了所假设的尼奎斯特速率，再比较那些采样记录。

entries.en: They ordered oysters Rockefeller to share while waiting for the main course.
entries.zh: 等主菜时，他们点了洛克菲勒焗牡蛎分着吃。

entries.en: The repairer photographed the damaged PC board before ordering a replacement.
entries.zh: 维修人员先拍下受损的印制电路板，然后订购替换件。

entries.en: She compared the observed counts with predictions from a Poisson distribution.
entries.zh: 她把观测计数与泊松分布给出的预测作了比较。

entries.en: The students rewrote the expression in Polish notation before comparing their answers.
entries.zh: 学生们先用波兰表示法改写表达式，然后比较答案。

entries.en: We bought a quiche Lorraine for lunch and ate it in the garden.
entries.zh: 我们买了一个洛林奶蛋糕当午饭，在花园里吃了。

entries.en: The programmer tested the example using a RAM disk rather than a physical drive.
entries.zh: 程序员用RAM虚拟盘而不是物理驱动器测试了那个示例。

entries.meaningZh: 真货〔非正式用语，此处指纯正威士忌〕
entries.en: The whisky turned out to be the real McCoy, not a cheap imitation.
entries.zh: 那威士忌确实是真货，并非廉价仿品。

entries.meaningZh: 反波兰表示法；逆波兰表示法
entries.en: She checked the calculator's reverse Polish notation settings before starting the exercise.
entries.zh: 她在开始练习前检查了计算器的反波兰表示法设置。

entries.en: The tutor compared two diagrams used to introduce Riemannian geometry.
entries.zh: 导师比较了两幅用于介绍黎曼几何的示意图。

entries.en: The student borrowed an introductory book on Riemannian geometry for the seminar.
entries.zh: 那位学生为研讨课借了一本黎曼几何入门书。

entries.en: The satellite TV stopped working halfway through the evening news.
entries.zh: 晚间新闻播到一半时，卫星电视不能用了。

entries.meaningZh: 特斯拉〔磁通量密度单位〕
entries.en: The engineer checked the magnetic flux density readings in teslas before plotting them.
entries.zh: 工程师在绘图前，核查了以特斯拉为单位的磁通量密度读数。

entries.en: The notebook contained several drawings made during their journey through the Alps.
entries.zh: 笔记本里有几幅绘于他们穿行阿尔卑斯山脉期间的画。

entries.meaningZh: 大洪水〔《创世记》叙事中的事件〕
entries.en: The seminar compared two paintings depicting the Flood in the Genesis narrative.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了两幅描绘《创世记》叙事中大洪水的画作。

entries.en: The class traced the Turing machine's states through a short example.
entries.zh: 全班通过一个简短示例，追踪了图灵机的状态变化。

entries.meaningZh: 土耳其头饰结〔绳索装饰结〕
entries.en: The museum displayed a worn rope with a Turk's head near one end.
entries.zh: 博物馆陈列了一根磨损的绳子，靠近一端有个土耳其头饰结。

entries.en: The form recorded her blood as type A but left the next box blank.
entries.zh: 表格记下她的血型为A型，却把下一栏留空了。

entries.meaningZh: B型行为模式〔心理学概念〕
entries.en: Her essay compares type B with a more hurried pattern of behaviour.
entries.zh: 她的文章将B型行为模式与一种更匆忙的行为模式作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 极北地区；遥远而不为人知的地区
entries.en: The explorer's memoir presents the distant valley as an ultima Thule.
entries.zh: 那位探险者的回忆录将那座遥远山谷写成一个鲜为人知的极远之地。

entries.en: The technician found an old manual for the UNIX operating system beside the terminal.
entries.zh: 技术员在终端旁找到了一本旧UNIX操作系统手册。

entries.en: The teacher used a Venn diagram to compare the two groups of books.
entries.zh: 老师用文氏图比较了那两组书。

entries.en: The students compared two drawings of a Wheatstone bridge before the laboratory demonstration.
entries.zh: 实验演示前，学生们比较了两幅惠斯通电桥图。

entries.en: The exhibition showed how the World Wide Web appeared on early computer screens.
entries.zh: 展览展示了万维网在早期计算机屏幕上的样子。

entries.en: The novel portrays a young Turk challenging the committee's cautious leadership.
entries.zh: 这部小说刻画了一位挑战委员会谨慎领导作风的少壮改革派人物。

entries.en: The engineer checked the units of Young's modulus before comparing the two materials.
entries.zh: 工程师先核查了杨氏系数的单位，再比较那两种材料。

entries.en: We compared two simulated paths of the Markov chain before discussing convergence.
entries.zh: 我们比较了这条马尔可夫链的两条模拟路径，然后讨论收敛性。

entries.en: Her conservative approach to the redesign preserved most of the original layout.
entries.zh: 她对重新设计采取保守做法，保留了大部分原有布局。

entries.en: The painter added a small saint to the unfinished altar picture.
entries.zh: 画家在尚未完成的祭坛画里添上了一个小小的圣徒形象。

entries.en: The actor left the wooden trident beside the stage after rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练后，演员把木制三叉戟放在舞台旁。

entries.en: The old mineral analysis listed titanic oxide separately from iron oxides.
entries.zh: 那份旧矿物分析将二氧化钛与铁的氧化物分开列出。

entries.en: The students compared drawings of Paleolithic tools during the museum visit.
entries.zh: 参观博物馆时，学生们比较了旧石器时代工具的图画。

entries.en: An elderly thespian in the novel returns to the theatre after many years away.
entries.zh: 小说里的一位年迈戏剧演员离开多年后，又回到了剧院。
